title: Cyber Security Audit
agency_path: City of New York > Parks and Recreation
description_text: NYC Parks would like to partner with an outside vendor that specializes in a Cyber Security Assessment process and in building security strategies. This strategy will align with OTIs Cyber Command and industry best practices. This assessment will be able to provide NYC Parks direction on our current security vulnerabilities; build a roadmap for improving our overall security posture and strengthen our alignment for the city; and identify and validate weaknesses in the NYC Parks information security architecture and posture from both an internal and external vantage point.
